theorems.statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} {U : Set (Amb n ℓ)} (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj ((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict V.carrier) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict V.carrier), (∃ P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n V.carrier V.mult x P) ∧ V.HasDensity x (V.mult x)
